title: Alpha Launch!
excerpt: Welcome to the alpha launch of EQ.gd! We are incredibly excited to open the doors... [Click]
content:
Welcome to the alpha launch of EQ.gd! We are incredibly excited to open the doors to our early testers.

Over the past few months, the dev team (kael) has been working tirelessly to build a solid foundation. In this alpha, you will be able to explore all the classic zones, test combat mechanics, and help us identify bugs.

Please join our Discord(WIP) to report any issues you find. Enjoy the game!
